whatsapp.title: WhatsApp
whatsapp.lgpd_consent_request: To continue, we need your consent to process your data under LGPD. Reply YES to accept or NO to refuse.
whatsapp.lgpd_optout_confirmed: You have been removed from our lists. We respect your decision. To reactivate, just ask.
whatsapp.bot_menu:
Hello! I'm the virtual assistant for {{clinic}}.

1 — Book appointment
2 — Confirm appointment
3 — Reschedule
4 — Cancel
5 — Talk to an agent
6 — Address and hours
7 — Communication preferences
8 — Privacy and personal data

Reply with the number or a command (AGENT, STOP, PRIVACY).
whatsapp.prefs_menu:
Communication preferences:

• STOP — pause news and promotions
• CANCEL MESSAGES — choose what to stop
• AGENT — talk to the team

Appointment reminders stay active if you have administrative consent.
whatsapp.privacy_menu:
Privacy and data (LGPD):

• MY DATA — request access
• Delete data — open a deletion request (clinical records may be legally retained)
• AGENT — talk to reception/DPO

Marketing deletion does not erase the medical record.
whatsapp.cancel_messages_clarify:
Do you want to:
1 — Stop news/promotions only
2 — Stop all clinic WhatsApp

Reply 1 or 2. Appointment reminders use a separate consent.
whatsapp.emergency_notice: This channel does not provide emergency care. In an urgent situation, seek emergency services immediately or call the applicable public emergency number.
whatsapp.clinic_info:
{{clinic}}

whatsapp.reminder_confirmed: ✅ Appointment confirmed. Thank you! See you soon.
whatsapp.reschedule_requested: We received your reschedule request. The scheduling team will contact you with available times.
whatsapp.nps_recovery: We're sorry your experience wasn't satisfactory. Your message was forwarded to the unit manager, who will contact you to understand what happened.

whatsapp.ask_date: Which day do you prefer? Reply with the date (DD/MM) or type TOMORROW.
whatsapp.ask_time: What time works best? Reply MORNING, AFTERNOON or EVENING.
